our_interpretation: The forecast concerns historians' assessments written during calendar 2043, not whether present-day commentators make similar arguments.
I read the plural as predicting a prevailing assessment in a representative body of relevant retrospectives, rather than requiring unanimity or allowing one selected author to settle it.
The retrospectives must make both judgments: initial overemphasis on LLMs and a consequential shift toward more structured systems with deeper comprehension.
criteria.support_condition: A representative body of intellectual historians' AI retrospectives written in 2043 endorses both specified judgments.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A representative body of such retrospectives explicitly rejects one or both judgments. Mere silence or failure to find retrospectives does not establish contradiction.
